title: Accuracy of Ottawa Ankle Rules to exclude fractures of the ankle and midfoot in children: a meta-analysis (Dowling 2009, Acad Emerg Med)
why: Pooled paediatric ankle-rule accuracy across 12 studies; sets the >5-year floor and names Salter-Harris I as the dominant miss

title: Validation of the Ottawa Ankle Rules in children with ankle injuries (Plint 1999, Acad Emerg Med)
why: Prospective ankle-rule validation, ages 2-16, two-site cohort of 670

title: Validation of the Ottawa Knee Rule in children: a multicenter study (Bulloch 2003, Ann Emerg Med)
why: Prospective knee-rule validation, ages 2-16, multicentre cohort of 750

title: Can the Ottawa knee rule be applied to children? A systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies (Vijayasankar 2009, Emerg Med J)
why: Pooled paediatric knee-rule accuracy across 3 studies; sets the >5-year floor, mirrors the Dowling ankle finding

title: Validation of the Ottawa ankle rules in children (Libetta 1999, J Accid Emerg Med)
why: Ankle-rule validation down to age 1, before-after radiography-rate design; the lower-age-floor lead named in the brief
